title: SandboxCommand
description: Control-plane -> sandbox-agent WS commands (technical plan §6.1). Every command carries the common envelope (type, messageId, sessionId, gen) so per-message gen-fencing (§3.2 'stale-gen inputs are rejected') does not rely solely on the connection-level X-Sandbox-Gen header. Field nullability convention used throughout /contracts: a property documented as 'nullable' is a REQUIRED key whose value may be JSON null (always sent, may carry no value); the sole exception is Prompt.conversationId, which is additionally OPTIONAL (both absence and null mean 'start a fresh conversation') per §6.1/§3.3.

Prompt.description: Dispatch a turn. Carries author identity (scmName/scmEmail) for git commit attribution (§6.1) and the plan-mode toggle (§8.1).

conversationId.description: OpenCode conversation id to resume. Absent or null both mean 'start a fresh conversation' (§3.3) — this is the one field in /contracts where omission and explicit null are deliberately synonymous.

model.description: Model override for this turn; null means use the session/plan default.

effort.description: Reasoning-effort override for this turn; null means use the default.

scmName.description: Git author name for commit attribution.

scmEmail.description: Git author email for commit attribution.

planMode.description: §8.1: dispatch into plan mode instead of direct execution.

receiptRequested.description: Technical plan §3.3, prompt receipts: true asks the agent to answer this prompt, and every later copy of it, with a prompt_received event whose messageId is 'prompt_received:{this messageId}', and never to run a copy twice. Sent only to a gen whose ready advertised capabilities.promptReceipt. Absent or false: no receipt is asked.

Stop.description: Cancel the in-flight turn. No fields beyond the common envelope.

Push.description: Push one or more repos. §6.1: CP awaits push_complete within 360s (that timeout lives in a later PR's platform/timeouts.go, not here).

repos.description: Per-repo push spec (§6.1). Repos are always a list (§3.4) — no scalar single-repo mirror.

remote.description: Remote name override; null means use the repo's configured default remote.

Snapshot.description: Request a filesystem snapshot. No fields beyond the common envelope.

Shutdown.description: Request an orderly sandbox shutdown. No fields beyond the common envelope.

Ack.description: Acknowledge one of the 6 critical event types by its deterministic ackId (§6.1 ack protocol).

GitSyncComplete.description: Acknowledge completion of the CP-side half of a git_sync step (stash/checkout/pop, §3.4). No fields beyond the common envelope.
